activity_overrides.reason: Sadat's 15 October 1970–1 September 1971 presidency falls after Syria's 1961 secession, when Egypt alone retained the United Arab Republic name. The Activity is therefore placed in Egypt's Nile Valley while the UAR polity itself remains transregional in the review queue.
